definitions.gloss: match; competition; playing against; facing off
definitions.explanation: A competitive encounter between two opponents or teams. Used in sports, games, and any head-to-head competition.

examples.japanese: {明日|あした}の{対戦|たいせん}{相手|あいて}は{強|つよ}い。
オンラインで{世界中|せかいじゅう}の{人|ひと}と{対戦|たいせん}できる。
examples.english: You can compete against people from around the world online.

examples.japanese: {去年|きょねん}の{大会|たいかい}で{二回|にかい}{対戦|たいせん}したチームとまた{当|あ}たった。
examples.english: We were matched again with the team we played twice at last year's tournament.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in sports reporting, video game culture, and competitive contexts. Used with する to mean "to compete against."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対戦|たいせん}{相手|あいて} (opponent)
- {対戦|たいせん}する (to compete against, to play against)
- {対戦|たいせん}{成績|せいせき} (head-to-head record)
- {対戦|たいせん}ゲーム (competitive game, versus game)

DISTINCTION FROM HOMOPHONE:
{対戦|たいせん} (match, competition) vs. {大戦|たいせん} (great war, world war). The kanji differ: {対|たい} (versus) vs. {大|たい} (great).
